title: Mariner 9's "Inca City" ruins near the Martian south pole
place_text: Near the south pole of Mars

tellings.quote: pictures of what looked like ancient ruins these ancient ruins were even in formally dubbed by their team as the Incan City

plain: In 1972 a NASA space probe called Mariner 9, which orbited Mars, sent back pictures near the planet's south pole of what looked like ancient ruins, and the team informally nicknamed the spot the "Incan City". Michels tells this himself, pointing to the probe's photographs, as a hint that Mars may once have had life or builders.
